I'm sorry your replacement didn't make it either. Yes, you may be eligible for one more. A replacement plant gets its own new 30-day guarantee from delivery, so if it died or declined significantly (for example, lost more than a third of its leaves, stem or root rot, or collapse) within that window, you can replace it once more.

To claim, go to "My Orders" within the 30 days and upload at least two photos (whole plant and close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back. Note that the plant sent as that second replacement has no guarantee of its own.

If the replacement is past 30 days from delivery, or the damage was from something not covered (like pests introduced after delivery or repotting into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days), it wouldn't qualify, and I can escalate to a Support Lead if you'd like it reviewed.
